name: ubuntu/gtk-app
title: GTK 4 app window
summary: Native Ubuntu app in Python with GTK 4 and libadwaita: window, header bar, actions and a desktop entry.
when: Use when the user wants a real desktop window on Ubuntu, opened from the app grid, not a page in a browser.

app_name.about: Name shown in the window title and under the icon.

app_id.about: Reverse-DNS application id; also the .desktop and icon file names and the folder under ~/.local/share.

next: Write every file under files/ into the user's project, then run python3 main.py and replace the places marked with a comment with the user's own screen and data.
